title: Morning, the tailgate
logline: The pup asleep on the Legacy's tailgate in morning sun, twelve, the flats beyond, a mug beside him this time — not the enamel one. The page lets him sleep through a morning.

panels.composition: An old three-legged dog asleep on the open tailgate of a station wagon in morning sun with a plain mug beside it, gold mudflats beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old three-legged dog asleep on the open tailgate of an old station wagon in morning sun with a plain mug beside it and gold tidal flats beyond, no words
